lesson.title: Wonder Fuels Antifragility
lesson.topic: How maintaining a sense of wonder can help individuals and systems grow stronger in the face of uncertainty and stress.
lesson.steelman: In what ways does fostering curiosity and openness to new ideas enhance an individual's ability to adapt and thrive in unpredictable environments?
lesson.example: Einstein's lifelong fascination with the mysteries of physics, which drove him to innovate and push the boundaries of scientific knowledge even as conventional wisdom was changing around him.

rationale: This lesson bridges the gap between philosophical wonder and practical resilience, showing how curiosity can be a powerful ally in building antifragile systems.
